summary.en: Alchemist Japan is the Tokyo edition of the Silicon Valley Alchemist Accelerator, focused on enterprise/B2B tech founders with global ambitions. It runs a ~3-month in-person Tokyo program (25+ startups/cohort) with a follow-on phase in the SF Bay Area, investing net USD $70K for 8% equity (up to $100K) plus $500K+ in partner credits, ending in an invite-only Showcase. Supported by JETRO, Mitsubishi Estate and One Capital.

summary.en: 500 Global has run accelerator programs in Japan since 2016 (as 500 Startups Japan), completing 13 programs and supporting 300+ Japanese startups.
